description: Defines interfaces, types, and functions related to native display management in Android, including display types, configurations, and acquisition/release functions.

classes.name: ADisplay
classes.description: Opaque handle for a native display

methods.name: ADisplay_acquirePhysicalDisplays
methods.description: Acquires a list of display handles; caller must free the list.

methods.name: ADisplay_release
methods.description: Releases display handles created by acquire function.

methods.name: ADisplay_getMaxSupportedFps
methods.description: Returns the maximum supported frames per second for a display.

methods.name: ADisplay_getDisplayType
methods.description: Returns the type of the display (internal or external).

methods.name: ADisplay_getPreferredWideColorFormat
methods.description: Gets the preferred wide color format for a display.

methods.name: ADisplayConfig_getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width in pixels of a display configuration.

methods.name: ADisplayConfig_getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height in pixels of a display configuration.

methods.name: ADisplayConfig_getFps
methods.description: Returns the refresh rate of a display configuration.

methods.name: ADisplayConfig_getCompositorOffsetNanos
methods.description: Returns the compositor vsync offset in nanoseconds.

methods.name: ADisplayConfig_getAppVsyncOffsetNanos
methods.description: Returns the application vsync offset in nanoseconds.
